title: AI Baroque Art Generator
summary: Make baroque art with AI: candlelit chiaroscuro, rich oil glazes, gilded ceilings and drama. Describe the scene, pick a baroque style, and generate.
body_markdown:
### What are the main characteristics of baroque art?


Baroque art is known for dramatic contrasts of light and dark, strong diagonal compositions, a sense of movement, rich deep colour, emotional intensity and grand scale, with painting, sculpture and architecture often combined into one theatrical whole.


### When was the baroque period?


The baroque period in art ran from about 1600 to 1750, starting in Rome and spreading across Catholic Europe, Spain, Flanders and the Dutch Republic before giving way to the lighter rococo style.


### Who are the most famous baroque artists?


The best known baroque artists include Caravaggio, Artemisia Gentileschi, Peter Paul Rubens, Rembrandt, Johannes Vermeer, Diego Velázquez and the sculptor and architect Gian Lorenzo Bernini.


### How do I make baroque art with AI?


Describe the scene with one light source and the shadows around it, such as a woman reading a letter by a single candle, ask for oil paint with glazes and craquelure, pick a baroque style, and generate. In Flick you can then animate the still into a clip.


### Can I make a baroque style video?


Yes. Generate the still first, then use it as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick, describe slow motion that suits the scene, such as a candle flickering or a wave breaking, and ask it to keep the oil painting look.


### Is the baroque art generator free?


Yes, it is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6 runs on it. Video models such as Seedance 2.5 need the Standard plan ($20 a month).
